dialogue.origin: こんばんは
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: こんばんわ相談員です。本日は宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm the counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you today.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 本日はどのようなご相談でいらっしゃいましたでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: はい、子供とのやりとりが上手くいかなくて悩んでいます
dialogue.content: Yes, I’m struggling with my interactions with my child.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね、、お子さんとのことは気になる部分ですよね
dialogue.content: I see. Matters with your child are very concerning, aren’t they?

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: はじめに、何とお呼びしたら宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: To begin, how would you like me to address you?

dialogue.origin: お母さんとでもお呼びいただけると…
dialogue.content: If you could call me “Mom”...

dialogue.origin: はい、、わかりました
dialogue.content: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.origin: では、、
dialogue.content: Well then...

dialogue.origin: お子さんとのどんなやり取りで上手く行ってないと感じてらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: What kind of interactions with your child make you feel that things aren't going well?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Well...

dialogue.origin: 息子はもうすぐ大学受験を控えてまして
dialogue.content: My son is about to take his university entrance exams.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 大事な時期ですよね
dialogue.content: It's a very important time, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: しかし、勉強がはかどっていない感じなんです
dialogue.content: But it feels like he's not making any progress with his studies.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、それはお母さんとして一番心配になりますよね
dialogue.content: I see... That must be your biggest worry as a mother.

dialogue.origin: しかも、コロナのせいで3年になってからは登校していなくて
dialogue.content: On top of that, he hasn't been going to school since his third year started because of COVID.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、、今年は登校できてないですよね
dialogue.content: That's right... they haven't been able to go to school this year, have they?

dialogue.origin: 家と塾しか勉強する場が無いんです
dialogue.content: The only places he can study are at home and at cram school.

dialogue.origin: なのに…
dialogue.content: And yet...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: ゲームをしている時間がとても長く
dialogue.content: He spends so much time playing games,

dialogue.origin: 心配になります
dialogue.content: and it worries me.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see... so that's the situation.

dialogue.origin: 現在はリモート授業ですが
dialogue.content: He has remote classes now, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 昨日は学校から電話がありまして
dialogue.content: Yesterday, I got a call from the school.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 提出物が出ていないので成績が危ないと言われたんです
dialogue.content: and they said his grades are at risk because his assignments haven’t been turned in.

dialogue.origin: なので
dialogue.content: So...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、それはすごく心配ですね
dialogue.content: I see... That is very worrying.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: なので、息子としっかりと話しをしてみたいのですが
dialogue.content: So I'd like to have a proper talk with my son,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 全くとりあってくれません
dialogue.content: but he won’t engage with me at all.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、それではお母さんとしてもとても不安になるますよね人生でとても大切な大学受験でもありますし
dialogue.content: I see. That would make you very anxious as a mother, especially since university entrance exams are such an important milestone.

dialogue.origin: 話しをしたいと言っても、適当に交わされてしまいます
dialogue.content: Even when I say I want to talk, he just brushes me off with some vague answer.

dialogue.origin: もう、どうしたらいいか
dialogue.content: I just don’t know what to do anymore.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、そのような対応されちゃうわけですね
dialogue.content: I see... so that's how he responds.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: はい、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: お話しいただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.origin: もう少し具体的なところお聞きしたいのですが、、
dialogue.content: I'd like to ask about some more specifics, if that's okay.

dialogue.origin: 今はなし頂いたところが、一番気になる部分ですか？他にも気になどこととかございますか？
dialogue.content: Is what you've just told me your main concern? Or is there anything else that's worrying you?

dialogue.origin: 息子は行きたい大学も決まっているので、それに向かって勉強して欲しいと思っているんです。
dialogue.content: My son has already decided which university he wants to go to, so I want him to study hard for it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、志望校は決めてらっしゃるんですね
dialogue.content: I see... so he has decided on his first-choice school.

dialogue.origin: なのに、本人に任せておくと、殆ど勉強はしておらず、ゲームばかりで
dialogue.content: And yet, when I leave him to it, he barely studies and just plays games all the time.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、心配しちゃいますよね
dialogue.content: I understand—that would worry you.

dialogue.origin: どういうつもりなのかわかりません
dialogue.content: I don't understand what he's thinking.

dialogue.origin: ですから、たまに大丈夫？とか課題は？
dialogue.content: So, sometimes I'll ask him, "Are you okay?" or "How are your assignments?"

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: などと声をかみるんですが、やってるから大丈夫、みたいなことを言ってごまかします
dialogue.content: but he just brushes me off, saying something like, “I’m doing it, so it’s fine.”

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 先生からは課題が出ていないと電話まできているというのに
dialogue.content: Even though the teacher has gone so far as to call to say assignments aren’t being submitted.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: はぐらかすばからなんです
dialogue.content: He's just so evasive.

dialogue.origin: ばかりなんです
dialogue.content: All the time.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: ますます不安になりますよね
dialogue.content: That must make you even more anxious.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ちなみにですが、息子さんの模試とかはどんな感じですか？
dialogue.content: By the way, how are his mock exam results?

dialogue.origin: 塾の面談ではやります！みたいなことをいうくせに、
dialogue.content: At the cram school meetings, he says things like, "I'll do it!" but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 散々です
dialogue.content: They’re terrible.

dialogue.origin: このままでは入れる大学があるか分かりません
dialogue.content: At this rate, I don’t even know if there will be any university he can get into.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、ですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 重要な大学受験ですし、もどかしい思いですよね
dialogue.content: It's such an important exam, it must be very frustrating for you.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、、
dialogue.content: By the way...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: 志望校への合格ラインはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Where does he stand in relation to the acceptance level for his first-choice school?

dialogue.origin: 合格ラインにはとどいていないです
dialogue.content: He hasn't reached the acceptance level.

dialogue.origin: B判定くらいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is he getting something like a B-rank?

dialogue.origin: それは…
dialogue.content: Well...

dialogue.origin: 見せてくれないので分からないんですよね
dialogue.content: He won't show them to me, so I don't know.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、ますます不安になっちゃいますね
dialogue.content: I see... that would make you even more anxious.

dialogue.origin: ええ、秘密は多いです
dialogue.content: Yes, he keeps a lot of secrets.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、そのような感じですね
dialogue.content: I see... so that's how it is.

dialogue.origin: 期末テストの成績なども隠しますし
dialogue.content: He hides his final exam results and things like that,

dialogue.origin: とにかく、成績は悪いですから
dialogue.content: in any case, his grades are poor.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、他にも、秘密と思われることとか、気になる事ございますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Is there anything else he seems to be secretive about, or anything else that concerns you?

dialogue.origin: 大学に行く気があるのかどうか…
dialogue.content: I’m not sure if he even wants to go to university...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、一番肝心な部分ですよね
dialogue.content: I see... that's the most crucial point, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そこは、、
dialogue.content: Regarding that...

dialogue.origin: ゲームが好き過ぎます
dialogue.content: He just loves games too much.

dialogue.origin: ご本人は何とおしゃってますか？
dialogue.content: What does he himself say about it?

dialogue.origin: やってるから大丈夫だと言うんです
dialogue.content: He says he's working on it, so it's fine.

dialogue.origin: 塾でやっているからと
dialogue.content: He says he's studying at cram school.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、でも成績結果を見ると・・・不安って感じなのですね？
dialogue.content: I see... But when you look at his grades... you feel anxious, is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 塾にはどのくらいの周期で行かれてますか？
dialogue.content: How often does he go to cram school?

dialogue.origin: 週に3回で、1回が50分授業のコマを2コマとっています
dialogue.content: Three times a week, and each time he takes two 50-minute class periods.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、そうしますと、ご自宅での学習時間は重要なってきますよね
dialogue.content: I see... In that case, his study time at home becomes very important, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お母様からみて、、
dialogue.content: From your perspective, as his mother...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんは進学について、どうお考えだと思いますか？
dialogue.content: How do you think your son views going on to university?

dialogue.origin: 多分、この程度でも何処かに入れると甘く考えているかと思います
dialogue.content: I think he's probably thinking naively that he can get in somewhere even with this level of effort.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、そう考える受験生も多いのも事実ですよね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... It's true that many students think that way...

dialogue.origin: 選ばなければ、何処があるでしょうが
dialogue.content: If he's not picky, I'm sure there's somewhere he could go, but...

dialogue.origin: お母様としては、志望校に入ってほしい感じですか？
dialogue.content: As his mother, would you like him to get into his first-choice school?

dialogue.origin: やる気が出ないつまらない生活が待っていそうで残念なんです
dialogue.content: I'm just sad that it seems like a boring, unmotivated life is waiting for him.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、せっかくの人生、、心配なっちゃいますよね
dialogue.content: I understand. It’s his precious life—you can’t help but worry.

dialogue.origin: やはり、活気のある中で刺激を受ける学校や生活を送って欲しいと願います
dialogue.content: I really hope he can go to a school and live a life where he's stimulated in a vibrant environment.

dialogue.origin: 見栄ではなく
dialogue.content: Not for the sake of appearances,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そこは、、いまの志望校であれば、叶えられそうですか？
dialogue.content: Do you feel his current first-choice school could offer that?

dialogue.origin: ですね
dialogue.content: I think so.

dialogue.origin: 本人が学校を訪ねて気に入った学校ですから
dialogue.content: He visited the campus himself and liked it.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、であれば、ぜひ志望校を目指して欲しいですよね
dialogue.content: I see... In that case, you'd really want him to aim for that school, wouldn't you?

dialogue.origin: そうなんですよ
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: 本人はその学校のどんなところに惹かれたのでしょうね？
dialogue.content: I wonder what it was about that school that attracted him.

dialogue.origin: サークルというか同好会で楽しそうな物があったようです。
dialogue.content: It seems there was a club, or perhaps a student group, that looked fun.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、そこ重要ですよね！
dialogue.content: I see... that's very important, isn't it!

dialogue.origin: それに、学生の雰囲気が馴染めそうだったと
dialogue.content: Also, he felt he could fit in with the student atmosphere.

dialogue.origin: なるほど！
dialogue.content: I see!

dialogue.origin: なぜ、エンジンがかからないのでしょう
dialogue.content: I wonder why he can't get motivated.

dialogue.origin: そういったお話は、よく息子さんとされてるんですね？
dialogue.content: Do you often have these kinds of conversations with your son?

dialogue.origin: たまに話してはくれます
dialogue.content: He talks to me about it sometimes.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、お話しされてるおはいい感じですね
dialogue.content: I see. It’s good that you’re having those conversations.

dialogue.origin: はい、、お母様、、ここまでお話し伺い、
dialogue.content: Yes, Mom... based on what I've heard so far,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お母様も気にされてるやる気スイッチが問題かと私も思いました。
dialogue.content: I also think the “motivation switch” you’re concerned about may be the issue.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: いまは、まだスイッチ入ってない感じですよね
dialogue.content: It feels like that switch hasn't been flipped yet, does it?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: でも、時間はもう無いです
dialogue.content: But there isn’t much time left.

dialogue.origin: お母様からみて、どうすればスイッチ入りそうですか？
dialogue.content: From your perspective, what do you think would flip that switch for him?

dialogue.origin: それが分からないんです
dialogue.content: That's what I don't know.

dialogue.origin: 友達も多分ゲーム好きですし
dialogue.content: His friends probably like games too,

dialogue.origin: 安心してしまうのでしょうか
dialogue.content: and I wonder if that makes him feel complacent.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、何か、ヒントというか、もしかしたら、みたいな部分ってございませんか？
dialogue.content: I see... Is there anything, any hint or a "maybe it's this" kind of feeling you have?

dialogue.origin: ゲームが邪魔して、勉強しないって感じですか？それか、、
dialogue.content: Do you feel that the games are getting in the way of his studying? Or...

dialogue.origin: 多分そうです
dialogue.content: Probably so.

dialogue.origin: 勉強に身が入らず、ゲームしてしまってるって感じではないですか？
dialogue.content: could it be that he can't focus on his studies, and so he ends up playing games instead?

dialogue.origin: そうです。これは、何度も話してきましたが、治らないですね
dialogue.content: Yes. I've talked to him about this many times, but it doesn't change.

dialogue.origin: ゲーム依存かも知れません
dialogue.content: He might be addicted to games.

dialogue.origin: そんな感じなのですね？
dialogue.content: That’s how it seems to you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ここまでで少し、
dialogue.content: Based on what we've discussed so far,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 私が感じたことお話しさせて頂いても宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: may I share something that I've noticed?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 受験生にありがちなのですが、ゲームが好きで勉強をしない、というよりも、勉強に身が入らず、ゲームをしてしまってる。というのは、
dialogue.content: This is common among students preparing for exams, but it's often not a case of 'he likes games so he doesn't study,' but rather 'he can't focus on studying, and so he ends up playing games.'

dialogue.origin: 進学する目的が、意図が、ご自身の中で明確になってない可能性を感じます。
dialogue.content: I feel it's possible that his purpose, his reason for going to university, isn't clear to him.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: もし、お子さんと、将来の夢、姿とか、、
dialogue.content: Perhaps if you and your son could talk about his future dreams, or the kind of person he wants to be...

dialogue.origin: 大学以降の生活など、先々の夢の話をされるとか、
dialogue.content: about life after university and his dreams for the future,

dialogue.origin: そのために、大学は必要か、あるいは、今何をすべきか、
dialogue.content: and discuss whether university is necessary for that, and what he needs to do now.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: など話し合いをされ、今大学を目指す目標と意図をはっきりさせてみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How about having a discussion like that to clarify his goals and reasons for aiming for university right now?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。それは何度かはなしてみて、その大学が良いと言っていたのですが…
dialogue.content: That makes sense. We've talked about it a few times, and he said that university was a good choice, but...

dialogue.origin: 本心では無いんですかね？
dialogue.content: I wonder if he was being sincere.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、それは息子さんご本人の意向でしたか？
dialogue.content: I see... Was that your son's own wish?

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 友達も同じ大学希望ですし
dialogue.content: A friend of his wants to go to the same university, too.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、先の夢、目標が明確になれば、、それに向かって何をしなければならないか、本人の想いであれば、
dialogue.content: I see... If his future dreams and goals become clear, and if it's truly his own desire, then he'll realize what he needs to do to achieve them,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: やる気スイッチはいるはずですが・・・
dialogue.content: his motivation switch should flip on...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: You're right.

dialogue.origin: もしかしたら、本気じゃない可能性もありますか？友達に合わせてとか・・・
dialogue.content: Is it possible he's not serious about it? That he's just going along with his friends?

dialogue.origin: 可能性はあります
dialogue.content: That's a possibility.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、そんな感じがしてきましたね
dialogue.content: I see... It's starting to sound that way.

dialogue.origin: 私が大学にこだわっているのもいけないんですかね？
dialogue.content: Is it wrong of me to be so fixated on him going to university?

dialogue.origin: どうでしょうか、、お母様としては将来のご本人の夢も考え、大学進学を考えてらっしゃるのですよね？
dialogue.content: I wonder... As his mother, you're thinking about university with his own future dreams in mind, correct?

dialogue.origin: 私が専門では駄目だなって思っているので
dialogue.content: It's because I feel a vocational school wouldn't be good enough for him.

dialogue.origin: 親の押し付けはNGですが、ご本人の夢に向けたことであれば
dialogue.content: Imposing a parent’s wishes isn't good, but if it’s aligned with his own dreams,

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫と思いまさすが・・・
dialogue.content: I think it should be fine...

dialogue.origin: その思いに応える為に一応大学目指してるは風を醸し出している可能性もあるかも知れません
dialogue.content: It's possible he's just pretending to aim for university to meet my expectations.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: もしその心配があるようなら、
dialogue.content: If you're worried about that,

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 再度、将来のことをご本人の夢、目標を伺ってみてはいかがでしょうか？親の希望ではなく・・・
dialogue.content: why not try asking him again about his future—his own dreams and goals, not your hopes as a parent...

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That makes sense.

dialogue.origin: やってみます
dialogue.content: I’ll try that.

dialogue.origin: どんな生き方をしたいと思ってるか。と
dialogue.content: Ask him what kind of life he wants to lead.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: はい、是非相談されてみてください。
dialogue.content: Yes, please do try talking with him about it.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.origin: こんなに心配されてるお母さんですから、息子さんもきっといい形の将来の夢をお持ちだと思います。
dialogue.content: With a mother who cares so much about him, I'm sure your son has wonderful dreams for his future.

dialogue.origin: 頑張ってください。まだ受験には間に合いますので。
dialogue.content: Keep up the good work. There's still time before the exams.

dialogue.origin: そうでしょうか、
dialogue.content: Do you think so?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます、諦めずに関わっていきたいと思います。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I’ll keep engaging with him and won’t give up.

dialogue.origin: 今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for today.

dialogue.origin: はい、息子さんの将来のために、頑張ってください。
dialogue.content: Yes, please do your best for your son's future.

dialogue.origin: 本日は有難うございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.origin: はい。頑張ります
dialogue.content: Yes. I'll do my best.

dialogue.origin: お疲れさまでした。これで失礼します。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your hard work. I'll end the session here.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

topic.sub: 子供とのコミュニケーション問題
